refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns an indexed array containing the name of all stream wrappers registered in the current request. The list includes the wrappers added with stream_wrapper_register, with the name as it was registered, and does not include a wrapper removed with stream_wrapper_unregister; stream_wrapper_restore puts a built-in wrapper back at the end of the list. It is reset at the end of the request, and it does not change with allow_url_fopen: http, https, ftp, ftps and data stay listed.
